'''Team 5''' (also written Team Five) is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. Players Committee wraps and Holotheatre interviews name [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Joe Olson]], and [[Phil Aasen]] as members. In 2021 Hayes also named [[Kyle Krueger]] and [[Cal Aldred]] in the same teammate sentence.<ref name="pc-2021nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/swccg-returns-to-live-major-events-olson-wins-us-nationals/ SWCCG Returns to Live Major Events; Olson wins US Nationals], Players Committee (19 July 2021)</ref><ref name="ht29">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VVrmnkpvghk Holotheatre Ep 29: What's Hayes Got To Do With It?], Star Wars CCG (28 July 2021)</ref><ref name="bwc2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-01-boston-winter-classic-boston-massachusetts-jan-10-to-11-2026/ 2026 Boston Winter Classic wrap], Players Committee</ref>

On 14 January 2021 Olson (GEMP '''arebelspy''') posted the standing roster in Star Wars CCG Slack #swccgdiscussion: active members who had played an event in the previous year were himself, [[Eric Hunter]], Hayes, Kyle, Cal (caldred), Phil, [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (Kryptofis), [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (MHT), and [[Justin Branch]] (Silverglen); inactive were JM, [[Stephen Cellucci]], and [[Ross Littauer]].<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion (T4CAZFREZ / C4BHV1KTK), Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> In January 2023 he added that Team 5 had someone in Poland, Ziemowit / Kryptofis.<ref name="slack-2023">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 12 January 2023</ref> The Players Committee's 2021 OCS wrap prints Silverglen as Justin Branch and MHT as Matthew Harrison-Trainor.<ref name="ocs2021">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious/ 2021 Online Championship Series Wrap – MHT victorious], Players Committee (29 November 2021)</ref> Kryptofis is the Username on Skwara's [[2012 World Championship]] Xerox sheets.

Barry Alperstein has been described on Holotheatre as doing his own thing with Hayes helping on decks; he is not listed here as a member.

== Results ==

At the 2021 U.S. Nationals in Denver, Olson won the title. Hayes finished second, conceding the final to teammate Olson.<ref name="pc-2021nats" />

Hayes told Holotheatre after the 2023 U.S. Nationals that Team 5 had three in the Top 8 and almost four, and that New Allies also had three, with a first-round team-kill (Hayes vs Joe; Sam vs Charlie).<ref name="ht-s4e14">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBRVy8vgDFg Holotheatre S4 E14: Nationals Recap with Hayes], Star Wars CCG (5 April 2023)</ref>

At the [[2023 World Championship]] Hayes defeated Casey Anis in the final. The quarterfinals included Hayes vs Joe (team-kill).<ref name="pc-2023w">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-world-championship-wrap-up-hayes-hunter-secures-his-first-crown/ 2023 World Championship Wrap-Up], Players Committee (24 August 2023)</ref>

Later PC wraps that print the team name:

* 2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix — "Team 5 member Joe Olson"
* 2026 Boston Winter Classic — "Team 5 member Phil"
* 2026 San Diego Super Open — "Team 5 member Joe"
* 2026 U.S. Nationals — "Team 5 member Hayes"; Olson and Aasen also Top 8<ref name="pc-2026nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-us-nationals-wrap-up-win-for-hayes-hunter/ 2026 US Nationals Wrap-Up], Players Committee</ref>
